nodes.description: Ownable._owner: address of the current contract owner, written in the constructor and by transferOwnership/renounceOwnership
ReentrancyGuard._status: reentrancy lock flag (1 = NOT_ENTERED, 2 = ENTERED)
mapping(address=>TokenLedger) holding supply, dividend, initialPrice and incrementPrice per registered token contract
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>BalanceLedger)) holding tokenBalance, referralBalance and payOut per wallet
mapping(address=>bool) tracking ERC20 contracts onboarded into the ecosystem
mapping(address=>bool) tracking wallets activated in the ecosystem
constant magnitude = 1e18 used to scale dividend accounting
msg.sender: untrusted caller used for balances, ownership assignment and payout destination
tokenOnboard(address,uint,uint): onlyOwner registration of a new ERC20 token with price parameters
buy(address) payable: purchases collateral with ETH via purchaseCollate(address(0), msg.value, _referredBy)
buy(address,uint256,address): purchases collateral by pulling ERC20 tokens with transferFrom
fallback() payable: implicit ETH purchase path that calls purchaseCollate
reinvest(address): converts accrued dividends and referral bonus into new collateral
exit(address): sells all collateral then withdraws dividends, composing sell and withdraw
withdraw(address): pays out dividends and referral balance in ETH or ERC20 tokens
transfer(address,address,uint256): transfers collateral to another wallet with a 10% dividend fee
sell(address,uint256): burns collateral, adjusts supply and payouts and recomputes the dividend
buyPrice(address): view returning current purchase price of one collateral unit
sellPrice(address): view returning current sell price of one collateral unit
tokentoCollateral_(address,uint): internal bonding-curve conversion from incoming tokens to collateral using sqrt
collateralToToken_(address,uint256): internal bonding-curve conversion from collateral to tokens
calculateCollateReceived(address,uint256): view wrapper over tokentoCollateral_ with dividend fee
calculateTokenReceived(address,uint256): view wrapper over collateralToToken_ with dividend fee
purchaseCollate(address,uint256,address): internal purchase engine updating supply, dividends, referrer balance and payouts
totalTokenBalance(address): view of contract ETH balance or ERC20 balanceOf(address(this))
totalSupply(address): view of tokenLedger supply for a registered contract
myTokens(address): view of the caller's collateral balance
myDividends(address,bool): view of the caller's dividends, optionally including referral bonus
balanceOf(address,address): view of any wallet's collateral balance
dividendsOf(address,address): view computing accrued dividends from dividend*balance - payOut
sqrt(uint): internal integer square root used by the bonding curve
renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner function clearing the owner
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner function assigning a new owner
owner(): view returning the stored owner address
payable(address(_customerAddress)).transfer(_dividends): external ETH transfer in withdraw
ERC20(contractAddress).transfer(_customerAddress,_dividends): external call to an arbitrary registered token in withdraw
ERC20(contractAddress).transferFrom(msg.sender,address(this),tokenAmount): external call to a user-supplied token in buy
tokenLedger.supply arithmetic and dividend recomputation in sell/transfer
dividend payout accounting arithmetic in purchaseCollate (magnitude scaling, payOut cast)
squared token amounts and scaling arithmetic inside collateralToToken_
exponentiation of prices/supply inside tokentoCollateral_ before SafeMath.sub
_owner = newOwner / _owner = address(0): privileged ownership state write
contractAddress parameter of tokenOnboard
initialPrice parameter of tokenOnboard
incrementPrice parameter of tokenOnboard
_referredBy parameter of buy/reinvest flow, fed into purchaseCollate
tokenAmount parameter of buy(address,uint256,address)
_amountOfCollate parameter of sell/transfer
toAddress parameter of transfer
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership
_incomingToken parameter of purchaseCollate
_customerAddress local derived from msg.sender in withdraw/exit/sell/transfer/purchaseCollate
_dividends local accumulating payout amounts in withdraw/reinvest/sell/transfer
_tokens local holding converted token amount in sell
_taxedToken local holding post-fee token amount in sell
collateAmount local returned by purchaseCollate in buy
_includeReferralBonus parameter of myDividends
_tokens parameter of collateralToToken_ pricing math
amount parameter of tokentoCollateral_ pricing math

edges.reason: Constructor sets _owner = msg.sender, making the untrusted caller the privileged owner
buy() is invoked by msg.sender and spends msg.value on its behalf
withdraw derives the payout recipient and dividend owner from the untrusted msg.sender
transfer uses msg.sender as the source holder of collateral
sell determines the seller and balance to burn from msg.sender
msg.sender gated by onlyOwner triggers the privileged _owner write in transferOwnership/renounceOwnership
The nonReentrant modifier checks and writes _status around withdraw, guarding the external transfer
withdraw forwards the computed dividend amount to the external ETH transfer
withdraw calls ERC20.transfer on an arbitrary registered token contract, handing control to external code
buy() executes ERC20.transferFrom on a token contract selected by the caller
buy(address,uint256,address) executes ERC20.transferFrom on the caller-supplied token contract
fallback() forwards the received ETH into purchaseCollate
buy() routes the ETH purchase through purchaseCollate
buy(address,uint256,address) routes the token purchase through purchaseCollate
reinvest dispatches a virtual buy order through purchaseCollate
exit sells the caller's entire collateral balance via sell
exit then calls withdraw to pay out dividends
transfer calls withdraw when outstanding dividends exist, allowing state to change mid-transfer
purchaseCollate converts the taxed token amount into collateral using tokentoCollateral_
purchaseCollate updates supply, dividends and payOut with magnitude-scaled arithmetic
sell mutates tokenLedger.supply and recomputes the dividend per token
sell prices the collateral through collateralToToken_
collateralToToken_ squares token amounts and scales by 1e18, risking overflow/underflow
tokentoCollateral_ exponentiates price and supply values before subtracting with SafeMath
tokentoCollateral_ calls sqrt to evaluate the bonding curve
tokenLedger.supply and price fields feed the pricing arithmetic in collateralToToken_
tokenLedger.supply state is mutated by the arithmetic in sell/transfer
balanceLedger payOut entries are updated by the arithmetic in purchaseCollate
withdraw updates payOut in balanceLedger before paying out dividends
buy(token) requires the token contract to be present in contractAddressRecord before pulling funds
purchaseCollate consults walletAddressRecord to decide whether the referrer is entitled to the referral bonus
magnitude scales the dividend amount that becomes the ETH transfer value
buyPrice derives the price through collateralToToken_
sellPrice derives the price through collateralToToken_
calculateCollateReceived delegates the conversion to tokentoCollateral_
calculateTokenReceived delegates the conversion to collateralToToken_
myDividends delegates dividend computation to dividendsOf
myTokens delegates the balance lookup to balanceOf
renounceOwnership clears the owner state variable to address(0)
transferOwnership writes the privileged _owner state variable
transferOwnership performs the privileged ownership write
contractAddress is written into contractAddressRecord and tokenLedger by tokenOnboard
initialPrice seeds tokenLedger.initialPrice in tokenOnboard
incrementPrice seeds tokenLedger.incrementPrice in tokenOnboard
_referredBy selects the referral branch inside purchaseCollate
tokenAmount is the amount pulled via transferFrom and passed to purchaseCollate
_amountOfCollate bounds and drives the supply and payout arithmetic in sell
toAddress receives the taxed collateral in transfer
newOwner is validated and stored as the new owner by transferOwnership
_incomingToken is split into dividend and collateral inside purchaseCollate
_customerAddress derived from msg.sender is the payout target of withdraw
_dividends becomes the value transferred in the external ETH payout
_tokens feeds the dividend split math in sell
_taxedToken is used in the payout adjustment arithmetic in sell
collateAmount is the collateral returned to the caller by buy
_includeReferralBonus switches dividend computation in myDividends
_tokens is squared and scaled by the pricing math in collateralToToken_
amount participates in the squared product inside tokentoCollateral_
buy(token) writes walletAddressRecord and requires contractAddressRecord on entry
